This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Ahmed El-Beyaliy, tested by 
eng. Saad Shawky Atalla, accepted by general manager eng Saad Ibrahem Kheder 
and approved by eng. Abd El-Moatey El-Rakaiby head sector of Mahmoudia PS. This 
document revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar , certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil 
general manager of quality control & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay head sector of inspection and quality control.

A work permit must be 
 issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Use standard personal 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles 
 protective clothing rubber gloves .... etc

The door of the battery 
 room must be provided with No smoking signs

The battery 
 instructions must be displayed visibly on the wall

Water source must be 
 available in the battery room

When working in the 
 battery room bewares of parts under voltage
Hydrometer
Digital voltmeter
Thermometer
Vaseline

Check the room 
ventilation

Keep the 
batteries clean and dry protect them against solid liquid and gaseous 
contamination

Inspect 
terminals of battery and clean any salt deposits with distilled water

Clean battery 
room floor with water

Inspect the 
outside of cells for cracks and leakage of electrolyte

Check acid 
level in central between max / min levels

Write down the 
voltage and acid density of every cell

If you found a 
detective cell, replace with a new one

Read over all 
voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card

Check terminal 
connectors for tightness

Lubricate 
terminals of cells with a thin film of Vaseline

Read and 
record overall battery voltage immediately after AC power is switched off

Connect the AC 
power again to battery charger and connect a load (floating condition)

Compare the 
reading you have taken to the readings recorded in previous readings

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Ahmed El-Beyaliy, tested by 
eng. Saad Shawky Atalla, accepted by general manager eng Saad Ibrahem Kheder 
and approved by eng. Abd El-Moatey El-Rakaiby head sector of Mahmoudia PS. This 
document revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar , certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil 
general manager of quality control & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay head sector of inspection and quality control.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Use standard personal 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles 
 protective clothing rubber gloves .... etc
The door of the battery 
 room must be provided with No smoking signs
The battery 
 instructions must be displayed visibly on the wall
Water source must be 
 available in the battery room
When working in the 
 battery room bewares of parts under voltage
Hydrometer
Digital voltmeter
Thermometer
Vaseline
Work to be carried out
Check the room 
ventilation
Keep the 
batteries clean and dry protect them against solid liquid and gaseous 
contamination
Inspect 
terminals of battery and clean any salt deposits with distilled water
Clean battery 
room floor with water
Inspect the 
outside of cells for cracks and leakage of electrolyte
Check acid 
level in central between max / min levels
Write down the 
voltage and acid density of every cell
If you found a 
detective cell, replace with a new one
Read over all 
voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card
Check terminal 
connectors for tightness
Lubricate 
terminals of cells with a thin film of Vaseline
Read and 
record overall battery voltage immediately after AC power is switched off
Connect the AC 
power again to battery charger and connect a load (floating condition)
Compare the 
reading you have taken to the readings recorded in previous readings
